title: NO GAMES - MON 2 & WED 4 NOV
message: Endeavour Hills Leisure Centre has cancelled our court bookings for Monday 2 and Wednesday 4 November after flooring was damaged during the centre's basketball-ring upgrade. FIS games cannot go ahead on either night.
resumeText: Games return MONDAY 9 NOVEMBER and WEDNESDAY 11 NOVEMBER.
